name: forge-ai-os
description: Personal AI OS — repo root. Hosts the pre-merge guard; forge-control, forge-control-web and forge-control-mcp are separate packages with their own package.json.

scripts.test: bash -c 'pnpm --dir forge-control test; s1=$?; pnpm --dir forge-control-web test; s2=$?; exit $(( s1 > s2 ? s1 : s2 ))'
